game.name: Nomolos: Storming the Catsle
game.desc: Nomolos the cat knight fights through 12 levels and four bosses to reach the evil Hippo in her Catsle. A two-way scrolling action platformer in the style of Castlevania and Ninja Gaiden, with a baroque soundtrack.

game.name: The Legends of Owlia
game.desc: Explore the land of Owlia, solve dungeons and collect items in a top-down action-adventure in the tradition of the classic NES adventures. Gradual Games' second NES game.
